rationale: Builds on the 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best script by adding one cheap export-surviving vector gate after the recurrent tail. The gate is initialized to zero, trained by the scalar optimizer, kept in fp32, and lets the model blend the recurrent output back toward the pre-recurrence decoder anchor when recurrence overshoots under final int8+zlib roundtrip. It preserves VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0, final exact evaluation, data paths, and the compact 600s shape family.
title: Recurrent Tail Exit Anchor Gate
